# Blog2Page: its buttons, fields and dropdowns

What the crawl saw on pages of this type that a visitor can use (links are in
ai/GLOSSARY.md), read only: nothing was clicked, typed or sent. Each locator matched exactly one element
on the page it was read from. Those it trusts are already in `Blog2Elements`, each with the method
that uses it; a fragile one (its locator counts positions) is not, and has a line to paste into the
**elements** YOURS block once checked against a saved page (ai/recipes/add-an-element.md). Controls on most pages (a footer form) are in
controls/Everywhere.md. Not listed: anything that appears only after a click, behind a login, or
after a form is sent; ask for a saved page of that.

## Header

- **`English (US)`**: `button`. Seen on 1 of 9 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/es-la/). In `Blog2Elements` as `ENGLISH_US_BUTTON`: `click().englishUs()`.
- **`Try It Free`**: `button`. Seen on 1 of 9 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/es-la/). In `Blog2Elements` as `TRY_IT_FREE_BUTTON`: `click().tryItFree()`.

- **`Цены`**: `button`. Seen on 4 of 9 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/ru/). In `Blog2Elements` as `BUTTON_2`: `click().button2()`.

- **`Português (BR)`**: `button`. Seen on 4 of 9 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/pt-br/). In `Blog2Elements` as `PORTUGUES_BR_BUTTON`: `click().portuguesBr()`.
- **`Preços`**: `button`. Seen on 4 of 9 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/pt-br/). In `Blog2Elements` as `PRECOS_BUTTON`: `click().precos()`.
- **`Experimente gratuitamente`**: `button`. Seen on 4 of 9 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/pt-br/). In `Blog2Elements` as `EXPERIMENTE_GRATUITAMENTE_BUTTON`: `click().experimenteGratuitamente()`.

- **`Поле поиска` / `Search`**: `search field`. Seen on 4 of 9 crawled pages (e.g. /blog/ru/). In `Blog2Elements` as `SEARCH_FIELD_INPUT`: `enter().searchField(...)`.
